# FPT.AI sandbox fixtures

Place real vendor-sandbox image fixtures here before running `npm run test:e2e:sandbox` with `CYPRESS_USE_FPT_SANDBOX=true`.

Required files:

- `id-front.jpg`
- `id-back.jpg`
- `license-front.jpg`
- `license-back.jpg`
- `selfie.jpg`

Do not commit real personal documents. Use FPT.AI-provided sandbox/sample documents only.
